task: find a local provider or place by criteria (Yelp, Google Maps): set the criteria — service, area, rating, price — search, compare candidates through ratings, reviews, photos, and details, cross-check between them, and settle on one; complete when the chosen place's details or contact page is on screen as the verdict. Surface pinned: a maps or local-reviews site/app. Variants: booking the appointment or reservation afterwards, and turn-by-turn navigation, do not belong.

tree.label: Find a local place by criteria
tree.note: 1 runs in every keeper. 2 fixes the area (e.g., the map's own view, a centered location, a typed city, an anchored place, or a route in 2.5). 3 names the service. 4 runs only where a filter or a sort is touched, which is four keepers. 5 reads what came back and 5.7 loops to 3 for a new word or category - three keepers run it three times. 6 compares the candidates, mostly from the results list. 7 opens one and reads it, and 8 checks what it says. 9 is where the choice is made, though nine keepers stop at 9.7 instead. 6.4 can send the task back to 7 for the next candidate. WECH, hJNv and CC-h each do this once.
